messages:
Sam Rodriguez: Heads-up: CVE-2026-9999 popped up in our image deps (libfoo). We need a staged base-image rebuild + re-signing. Two quick asks: RBAC for the signing principal, and audit log fields to carry build/digest. Also seeing a KMS mismatch in staging. Who can triage?
Maria Chen: On it — which images are affected, staging or prod?
Sam Rodriguez: staging first: redwood-runtime:2026-03-20 and ubuntu-minimal:2026-02. Filed INF-2237.
Devon Patel: I see cosign job failures: `error: signing failed: KMS key not found` — looks like the key alias rotated in staging KMS yesterday. @infra-bot can you print the last rotation event?
infra-bot: KMS rotation for alias projects/redwood/staging/signer occurred 2026-03-21T02:14Z by user:maria (change-id: rot-20260321). Previous key active for 72h.
Maria Chen: Ah — I rotated the key but forgot to update the image-bake service account binding. I'll add the svcacct grant now.
Irene Gomez: RBAC note: please don't give the bake SA broad crypto perms. Create a narrow role `roles/redwood.imageSigning` with `cloudkms.sign` + `logging.logEntries.create` and bind that. I'll draft the least-priv policy.
Devon Patel: We also need audit fields to record build_id and image digest. Current audit entries are vague. Would like `resource.labels.build_id` and `resource.labels.image_digest` in the log payload.
Sam Rodriguez: Yup — chain-of-custody is required. Add to the bake step: `--audit-meta build_id=$BUILD_ID digest=$DIGEST` so the pipeline injects structured log fields.
Maria Chen: I'll patch the bake pipeline and run a dry-run. Canary plan: rebuild 2 non-prod clusters, smoke test, monitor for 6h.
Irene Gomez: :thumbsup: I'll open the role PR. Ping me after pipeline change and I'll validate the IAM binding.
Devon Patel: On vuln: libfoo 1.2.5 fixes the issue, ~+2MB image size, no runtime API changes. Recommend force-rebuild runtime images after signing flow is green.
Sam Rodriguez: Plan: Maria updates IAM/pipeline EOD, Irene PR for role, canary tomorrow morning, then non-prod rollouts next week, prod after 48h observation. I'll post runbook link in incidents.
Maria Chen: Pushed pipeline change and started a dry-run: ```bake --image redwood-runtime:staging --set audit_meta=build=INF-2237,digest=sha256:abc123```
infra-bot: Dry-run completed: signature state `pending` due to missing KMS grant. Waiting on IAM update.
Irene Gomez: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/policies/pull/512 — role `roles/redwood.imageSigning` with `cloudkms.cryptoSign` and `logging.logEntries.create`.
Maria Chen: IAM binding updated. infra-bot, please retry signing job.
infra-bot: Re-run triggered by Maria at 2026-03-21T15:12Z. Signing succeeded. Signature: `cosign:v1:sha256:deadbeef`.
Devon Patel: Canary bake started on `cluster-canary-1`. Tests queued: startup, perf-smoke, e2e-keychain. Will report results in ~2h.
Sam Rodriguez: If canary is green we'll schedule rolling rebuild for all non-prod pools next week and prod after 48h observation. Thanks all. :eyes:
Irene Gomez: Also filing retention change for image-audit logs to 180d (for compliance). Opening INF-2240.
Maria Chen: INF-2240 created and tagged security/compliance.
oncall: Noted. Oncall monitoring updated: alert threshold set to 5 signing failures / 10m.
